cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear this shelf, but our allotment photo stays out. That summer gets a proper place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We grew three carrots. I need the shelf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You'll have the shelf. I'll find another spot. Those three carrots got us watering together every morning; that's the part we're keeping.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could put the photo on my desk at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, I'll clean the frame for you. And when someone laughs at the harvest, tell them about those mornings. You can tell it your way; I just want our summer to mean more than three carrots.
